exposure: Peripartum use of opioid agonist pharmacotherapy (buprenorphine or methadone)
outcome: 24-hour postoperative opioid consumption (excluding buprenorphine and methadone), in milligram morphine equivalents (MME)
Highest pain score on a 0 to 10 numerical rating scale in the first 24 postoperative hours
Postoperative length of stay in hours
finding: Parturients on opioid agonist pharmacotherapy have markedly increased opioid utilization and pain severity after cesarean delivery.
